scope: read-only validation diagnostics on existing PAMAP2 and PhysioNet results; no new training, datasets or Stage2
requested_result_identity: verify scene, model seed, split, masks from per-run plan and shared data manifest before evaluation

four_cells.E0C0: A1 own coarse_selected.pt with original coarse_projector retained
four_cells.E1C0: A0 own coarse_selected.pt with original coarse_projector retained

grouping.fraction_boundaries: left closed, right open, except last bin includes1
grouping.invisible_run_definition: per variable within the actual 96-point model input; consecutive NOT(originally-visible AND artificial-visible), truncated at input window edges
grouping.other_variable_visibility: fraction of the other C-1 variables actually visible at the same input time
grouping.score: native valid AND artificially hidden only, after 96-point reconstruction; no repeated patch copies

relative_difference: (baseline_error-treatment_error)/baseline_error*100; None if denominator0 or empty; positive means improvement
interpretation: phase contribution diagnostic; unequal capacity, budgets and selection objectives; descriptive, not additive independent causal effects
